name: Squat Thrust
steps: Stand in an athletic stance with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Drop your hips quickly and plant both hands firmly on the floor directly beneath your shoulders.
Kick both feet sharply backward into a braced high plank with your hips controlled and arms straight.
Snap both feet cleanly back outside your hands and rise briskly back into your athletic stance.
tips: Brace your abs and glutes tightly as your legs kick back so your lower back never sags toward the floor.
Land softly with flat feet on the jump forward before standing cleanly upright.
